chunks: 3. 'Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Imran al-Daqqaq (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Asadi said: Musa ibn 'Imran narrated to me, from al-Husayn ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Knowledge is part of His Perfection.

key_terms.الْعِلْمُ: Knowledge (specifically divine knowledge in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between God's Knowledge and His Perfection in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Tawhid*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies Knowledge (*'Ilm*) as a fundamental aspect of God's perfection, implying it is an essential attribute (*sifah dhatiyyah*) rather than an accidental addition. This aligns with the Shia theological emphasis on the unity of God's attributes with His essence, distinguishing divine Knowledge from the limited, acquired knowledge of creation.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 3. `Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad `Imran al-Daqqaq (RA) said: Muhammad ibn Ja`far al-Asadi said: Musa ibn `Imran, on the authority of al-Husayn ibn Yazid, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abu `Umayr, on the authority of Hisham ibn al-Hakam that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said:
“The Knowledge (of Allah) is part of His Perfection.”
